# Peanut Cheat Sheets

> Marketplace for buying and selling student-made cheat sheets for university
> courses. Sheets are sold as PDFs with previews; payment is via Thai
> PromptPay.

## Main pages

- [Browse cheat sheets](https://cheatsheets.npwitk.com/): search by course code, filter by institution/year, sort by price/rating
- [Mock exams](https://cheatsheets.npwitk.com/mock-exams)
